COPIED FROM THE RESEARCH FILE, NOT FROM AN OHIO DEPARTMENT OF TAXATION DOCUMENT.

Source: lib/taxes/taxcalcs/research/estimated-payments/oh.md, accessed and
verified 2026-10-20 (its "## Verification" section marks each quote below
VERIFIED, read in a browser). tax.ohio.gov answered a plain curl request for
each of these pages with an error page titled "403 Error Page" on 2026-10-20,
and the journal entry is a scanned image with no text layer, so the
documents themselves are not checked in. See SOURCES.md.

Each line is "[document] quote", copied character for character from the
research file. Lines that are the research file's own words rather than a
quote are marked "(research, not a quote)".

Document [FAQ]: Department of Taxation FAQ, "Income - Estimated Income/School
District Taxes and the 2210 Interest Penalty" (dated May 10, 2022)
https://tax.ohio.gov/help-center/faqs/income-estimated-incomeschool-district-taxes-and-the-2210-interest-penalty/income-estimated-income-school-district

[FAQ] Ohio law does not contain a specific safe harbor for first time filers.
[FAQ] New residents who have income not subject to withholding should begin making estimated payments by the next due date after moving into Ohio.
[FAQ] Part II of form IT/SD 2210 is used to calculate the interest penalty.
[FAQ] until the later of when the installment is paid or the return is due
[FAQ] their estimated payment due date and return due date is the same for Ohio income tax purposes.

Document [NEWS]: Department of Taxation news item, "2210 Interest Penalty on
underpayment of estimated tax" (dated May 07, 2025)
https://tax.ohio.gov/home/news-and-events/all-news/2210-interest-penalty

[NEWS] is required by law and cannot be removed.

Document [AJE]: Administrative Journal Entry, interest rate for calendar year
2026, dated October 15, 2025 (scanned image; the research read it as an image)
https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/tax.ohio.gov/individual/2026_Interest_Rates.pdf

[AJE] the interest rate prescribed by R.C. 5703.47 for calendar year 2026 is seven percent (7%).

Document [RATES]: Department of Taxation, Annual Certified Interest Rates page
https://tax.ohio.gov/researcher/interest-rates

(research, not a quote) [RATES] The department's interest rate page lists rates only through 2026 as of 2026-10-20.
